Flydubai Jet Plunged 14,000 Feet in Under a Minute

A Flydubai passenger jet experienced a rapid descent, falling approximately 14,000 feet in about 30 seconds. The incident resulted in damage to the aircraft, attributed to extreme speeds, angles, and G-force loads.
